question: Does the local AutoLab replay X1/X3, refuse a mixed-frame alpha fit, and report whether chained-x or chained-sym FFD grows at m=4?

boundaries.success: OLS slope of log2(Q/Q_enum) vs ell <= -0.5 (alpha <= 1.5) over >=4 agreeing m=3 rungs with |F| >= 3 in one frame
boundaries.x5_falsifier: FFD max grows with n at m=4 on ell > 1

beats.note: T4 D=3 k=8, 12 targets vs freeze 11. Within protocol rel_tol=0.05. Not a new alpha.
OLS is per frame. Mixing chained X1 with symmetrised X3 is inadmissible. A two-point sketch is not a fit.
Chained x-system. Agrees with the scaling-target incumbent FFD max=3 on chained m>=3. Superseded as a smoke by the 16-draw promotion.
16-draw promotion of chained-x. FFD max=3 at n=9 and n=15, m=4. Does not grow. Not the chained symmetrised S3.

beats.protocol: build_chained_symmetrised_system; divisor_for_dimension(n,(n+1)/m); d_max=4 seed=0x5EED FFD_TRIALS=4 a=0
beats.note: n=7 ell=1 has no FB bits; interior S3 collapses to degree 1. H1 is read from ell>1: FFD=4 at n=9 and n=15. Four draws is a smoke; 16-draw promotion agrees.

beats.protocol: build_chained_symmetrised_system; divisor_for_dimension(n,(n+1)/m); d_max=4 seed=0x5EED FFD_TRIALS=16 a=0
beats.note: 16-draw promotion. H1 (FFD growing with n at m=4, ell>1) is not met. Not an advance against the product-law floor. Not unchained S4.

verdict: No alpha. Chained-x FFD max=3 at n=9 and n=15 over 16 draws, does not grow. Chained-sym FFD max=4 at n=9 and n=15 (ell=3) over 16 draws, does not grow; n=7 ell=1 is a degree-1 collapse, not H1. Product-law floor untouched. Harbor not required.
